table.name: asset_pages
table.purpose_zh: 每个资产一条当前网页记录，保存网页位置与最后成功更新时间；不累积逐次版本。
table.purpose_en: One current webpage record per asset, with its location and last successful update time.

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 assets.asset_id 的同一 UUID；每资产一行

columns.name: page_ref
columns.label_zh: 当前可用网页的地址或文件引用

columns.name: updated_at
columns.label_zh: 网页最后成功制作或更新完成时间；旧时间未知可空

table.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_pages (asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), page_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(page_ref)) > 0), updated_at TEXT)

provenance_zh: 工作台结构与一行假设案例，不是实际网页或业务记录；物理存储、网页生成与读取器未接入。
provenance_en: Studio schema and one fictional row, not an actual webpage or business record; storage, generation and readers are unconnected.
rules_zh: 按 asset_id 唯一定位当前网页；没有网页的资产可以没有这一行。
网页成功制作或更新后新增/更新该资产这一行的 page_ref 和 updated_at，不追加逐次版本，不保存 page_version_id。
updated_at 是网页成功更新完成时间，不是素材时间、检查时间或失败重试时间；失败保留旧网页与旧成功时间。
本表不存正文、JSON 素材、素材发布时间或历史网页快照；素材管理与增量生成属于其他流程。
资产 UUID 的关联保留在字段定义，不画 #1001 → #1039 身份线；#3029 按候选 UUID 读取当前网页记录。
一天或三天的整页更新周期尚未选定，保持未配置，不沿用 #1019 的分栏目30分钟。
工作台不执行实际网页更新或原子写入；真实保存器须防止迟到的旧结果覆盖较新的成功记录。
rules_en: The asset UUID is the primary key; an asset without a webpage may have no row.
After successful creation/update, upsert that asset’s page_ref and updated_at. Do not append versions or store a page_version_id.
updated_at is the actual successful page completion time, not material time, check time or failed retry time. Failures preserve the prior successful row.
Page bodies, materials, material timestamps and historical snapshots belong outside this table. Incremental generation is a separate workflow.
Keep the assets UUID reference in the field definition, without an assets-to-page graph line; #3029 reads by candidate UUID.
The daily versus three-day whole-page interval is undecided. Do not inherit #1019’s per-information 30-minute interval.
Studio does not execute page generation or atomic writes; runtime writers must reject stale completions.
case_note_zh: 本行是同一资产当前网页的假设格式；example.invalid 不可访问。再次成功更新时覆盖这一行的位置与成功时间，不再添加第二行。
case_note_en: A fictional current webpage record. example.invalid is not a working page. A subsequent successful update replaces this asset’s location/time, without adding another row.

rules_zh: #3027 筛选候选资产并传递 UUID；#3029 再按 asset_id 查 #1039 的当前网页记录。
成功完整查询无记录时需首次制作；有有效 updated_at 且达到已配置整页间隔时需更新，否则跳过。
整页间隔尚未选定一天还是三天；未配置时不对已有网页作过期结论，不套用 #1019 的30分钟。
查询失败或不完整不当作无网页；时间未知、无效或在未来则待核对，不伪造年龄。
将 #1039.updated_at 映射为 #3029.page_updated_at，与 #1019.last_success_at 的分栏目内容时间分开。
读取不触发生成；本次仅交付工作台连接定义。增量更新、真实读取器及写入器尚未实施。
rules_en: #3027 selects asset UUIDs; #3029 looks up each current webpage record in #1039.
A successful complete empty lookup requires first generation. An existing page is due only when its valid updated_at reaches the configured whole-page interval; otherwise skip.
Daily versus three-day timing is undecided. With no interval, do not classify existing pages as expired or inherit #1019’s 30 minutes.
Failed/partial reads are not missing pages. Unknown, invalid or future times need review.
Map #1039.updated_at to #3029.page_updated_at, separately from #1019.last_success_at for per-information content.
Reading does not trigger generation. This is design wiring; incremental updates and real readers/writers remain unimplemented.
